# hwatu

> Headless browser for agents (CLI and MCP). Runs on the user's machine.

hwatu is driven by agents through a CLI and MCP. Linux is supported today.
macOS and Windows are targets.

Commands: act (`goto`, `click`, `type`, `fill`, `scroll`, `upload`), observe
(`snapshot`, `content`, `eval`, `shot`, `console`, `net`), assert (`expect`,
`diff`, `motion`). `hwatu batch` runs a sequence in one call.

Skills live in the agent harness. A skill is a `SKILL.md` that calls `hwatu`
commands. This project has no skill library.

The browser is visible only through `show`. Login walls and irreversible
actions (pay, send, delete) return structured stops, and the agent asks the
user. CAPTCHAs are handled by the agent with `challenge`, `shot`, `snapshot`,
`click --trusted`, and `type`. If a challenge cannot be cleared, `challenge`
returns a structured block and the agent can hand off through `show`. There
are no solver services, token injection, or fingerprint spoofing.
